title: Updates for Getting Payment on the GeneDx Holdings $21M Settlement
author: 11thestate
selftext:
Hey guys, if you missed it, GeneDx Holdings has agreed to a $21M settlement with investors over claims that shareholders were misled in connection with the company’s 2021 de-SPAC merger. And, I just found out that late claims are still being considered for compensation, subject to approval.

Quick recap: In 2021, CM Life Sciences, which later became Sema4 and now operates as GeneDx Holdings, was accused of misleading shareholders about the de-SPAC merger and denying them a fully informed choice about redeeming their shares.

Now, the company has agreed to settle for $21M, and even though the deadline has passed, late claims are still being considered, subject to approval.

So, if you invested in $WGS at that time, you may still be able to file a late claim [here](https://11th.com/cases/cmls-investor-settlement).

Anyway, has anyone here invested in $WGS? How much were your losses, if so?
